heading: Waging war against any Asiatic Power in alliance with the Government of India.
text: Whoever wages war against the Government of any Asiatic Power in alliance or at peace with the [1][Government of India] or attempts to wage such war, or abets the waging of such war, shall be punished with [14][imprisonment for life], to which fine may be added, or with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, to which fine may be added, or with fine.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by the A. O 1950, for “Queen”.
Subs. by Act 26 of 1955, s. 117 and the Sch., for “transportation for life or any shorter term” (w.e.f. 1-1-1956).
